title: Where do escalator steps actually go? #shorts
description: Escalator steps ride a chain loop: each has two sets of wheels on two tracks, the gap between the tracks makes them stand up as stairs or fold flat at the landings, they flip upside down to return underneath, and grooves mesh with the comb plate. 'Escalator' was a trademark (Otis) until 1950. Sources: HowStuffWorks, KONE, Hackaday, Encyclopedia.com, Smithsonian Air & Space, Wikipedia.
